explained.summary: A note pointing to the old fable of the country mouse and the town mouse. The town mouse has rich food but lives in fear of being caught, while the country mouse has plain fare and peace. Marcus wants the reminder that a simpler life without the alarms can be the better bargain.
explained.today: Think of the bigger house with the bigger mortgage, or the high-paying job that leaves you checking emails at midnight. The plainer option, with fewer things to lose, often comes with more calm.
